## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Promotion is gated on the recorded shadow disagreement rate and vindication...

The system SHALL ensure that promotion is gated on the recorded shadow disagreement rate and vindication split, both cited in the change's rationale with the thresholds chosen from them.

#### Scenario: Promotion is gated on the recorded shadow disagreement rate and vindication...

WHEN `promote-shadow-judgments-to-acting-decisions` is implemented
THEN Promotion is gated on the recorded shadow disagreement rate and vindication split, both cited in the change's rationale with the thresholds chosen from them.

### Requirement: A test asserts that claimed/judged disagreement below approve_floor...

The system SHALL ensure that a test asserts that claimed/judged disagreement below approve_floor transitions to escalate with both labels present in the escalation evidence.

#### Scenario: A test asserts that claimed/judged disagreement below approve_floor...

WHEN `promote-shadow-judgments-to-acting-decisions` is implemented
THEN A test asserts that claimed/judged disagreement below approve_floor transitions to escalate with both labels present in the escalation evidence.

### Requirement: The premium-tier GATEKEEPER archetype dispatch is removed from the autopilot...

The system SHALL ensure that the premium-tier GATEKEEPER archetype dispatch is removed from the autopilot run path and complexity_gate.default_gate_verdict remains the headless fallback, covered by a headless-run test.

#### Scenario: The premium-tier GATEKEEPER archetype dispatch is removed from the autopilot...

WHEN `promote-shadow-judgments-to-acting-decisions` is implemented
THEN The premium-tier GATEKEEPER archetype dispatch is removed from the autopilot run path and complexity_gate.default_gate_verdict remains the headless fallback, covered by a headless-run test.

### Requirement: Per-run judged-call cost for a reference autopilot run is recorded and is...

The system SHALL ensure that per-run judged-call cost for a reference autopilot run is recorded and is under one cent.

#### Scenario: Per-run judged-call cost for a reference autopilot run is recorded and is...

WHEN `promote-shadow-judgments-to-acting-decisions` is implemented
THEN Per-run judged-call cost for a reference autopilot run is recorded and is under one cent.

### Requirement: Every promoted decision reaching a report carries evidence_class "judgment"...

The system SHALL ensure that every promoted decision reaching a report carries evidence_class "judgment" and its probability; no deterministic gate is bypassed, asserted by the scope-safety floor tests.

#### Scenario: Every promoted decision reaching a report carries evidence_class "judgment"...

WHEN `promote-shadow-judgments-to-acting-decisions` is implemented
THEN Every promoted decision reaching a report carries evidence_class "judgment" and its probability; no deterministic gate is bypassed, asserted by the scope-safety floor tests.
